name: District
description: District is Eternal Ltd's (NSE/BSE: ETERNAL, formerly Zomato) 'going-out' vertical spanning dining and entertainment ticketing, built partly on the Aug 2024 Paytm ticketing acquisition. Stock price reflects all of Eternal.

stock.note: Reflects all of Eternal Ltd, not District specifically. 52-week range ₹212.60-₹368.45; market cap ~₹3.12 lakh crore.

source.name: Eternal Annual Report FY25 via Medianama
Eternal Annual Report FY25 via Medianama

marketing_spend.derivation: Per Medianama (Jul 2025), Eternal's FY25 'Advertisement and sales promotion expenses grew 38% YoY to Rs 1,972 crore in FY25… marketing of the District app contributed to this rise' (FY24: ₹1,432 crore). PMAR 2026 also names Eternal Ltd/Zomato in the top-10 at ₹1,000-1,100 crore AdEx (2025), corroborating at Tier 2. District-only marketing is not separately split out, so the ₹1,972 crore parent line is used as the disclosed anchor.
